action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy: For a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. The user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference. After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'exchange requested'.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User confirmed exchange of robotic vacuum (item ID: 6259501109) for bagless canister vacuum (item ID: 7958300294), and agreed to refund via PayPal after being informed that gift card was not available.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The user was authenticated, provided the order and item to exchange, selected a valid replacement of the same product type, was informed of the available payment/refund options, and gave explicit confirmation to proceed with the exchange and refund to PayPal. All policy requirements were met.
